newsitem.title: SYRIA: Mubarak leaves Syria after talks with Assad.
newsitem.headline: Mubarak leaves Syria after talks with Assad.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak left Damascus on Monday after talks with President Hafez al-Assad on latest developments of the Middle East peace process.
Presidential spokesman Joubran Kourieh said that Assad and top Syrian officials saw Mubarak off at Damascus airport.
Mubarak has criticised the current Israeli government of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for abandoning the land for peace formula.
